pattern: ^SELECT MIN\(.*\) FROM (.*?) WHERE (.*?) NOT IN \(\s*( SELECT .* FROM\s*.* UNION ALL SELECT .* FROM\s*.*)
correction: Join the tables correctly and filter out students who have any friends by using a subquery that selects only distinct student_ids from the Friend table.

metadata.description: This rule identifies SQL queries with incorrect subqueries in the NOT IN clause, and suggests a correction by joining the tables correctly and filtering out students who have any friends.
